title: Two-story house with a garage apartment addition
source: Plan set: draft main and upper floor plans and elevations for the addition, with the full plan set floor plans, elevations and sections for the house (1/4 inch = 1 foot).

rooms.name: Garage
rooms.text: Garage, extended 9 ft to the west

stages.label: House
stages.line: The finished house: a two-story house with the garage wing raised into a new upper apartment under an 8:12 gable, reached by an outside stair. Choose Explore to turn the model or go to a room.

stages.label: Garage side
stages.line: The garage side: the extended garage and its 16 foot door under the new apartment, the covered entry porch of the house, and the new gable rising to 27 feet.

stages.label: Roof
stages.line: The roof lifts away: the new gable over the apartment, the two gables over the house with the low flat section between them, and the hipped porch roof.

stages.label: Upper floor
stages.line: The upper floor: the new apartment over the garage with a bedroom, a bath, laundry and an open living room and kitchen, beside the master suite and two bedrooms of the house.

stages.label: Main floor
stages.line: The main floor: the garage extended 9 feet, the utility room and kitchen in the wing, and the dining room, living room, bath and two bedrooms of the house with its U stair.

stages.label: Floor
stages.line: The main floor deck about a foot over the ground, the garage slab at grade and the outside stair along the west wall.

sheetLabel: Static plan of the main floor of a two-story house with a garage apartment addition.
assumptions: Levels are scaled from the elevations and the section: main floor about 1 foot over the garage slab, the house upper floor 8 feet 8 3/4 inches above it, the apartment floor at about 8 feet 11 inches over the slab.
The 27 foot ridge of the new gable is printed; the plate heights, eaves and the flat section between the two house gables are scaled from the elevations.
Rake overhangs of the two house gables are drawn at 1 foot; the plans do not dimension them.
The outside stair is drawn with equal risers and a mid landing at half height; open treads, posts and guards are simplified.

The fireplace box in the garage is taken from the full plan set (the draft plan does not redraw it); its 4 foot height is assumed. The chimney is drawn only above the roof, since the draft plan does not show how it passes the new kitchen.
The step up from the garage to the kitchen door and the furred wall around it are read from the plan lines and not dimensioned.
Interior wall heights and ceilings are scaled from the sections. No room areas are printed, so labels show names only.
The window on the west wall of the house upper floor where the apartment meets it is removed and filled in, as noted on the draft plan.
The step outside the north sliding door is drawn on the north elevation; its 3 foot depth is assumed.
Window and door sizes come from the size tags and the elevations; sills not printed are scaled.
